reason_for_revision.discovery: The legacy TNG target is a 0.3125 Mpc/h NGP particle-count grid, while the legacy SIMBA target is a CAMELS Multifield Dataset grid produced with an adaptive 32-neighbour particle kernel and then resampled from 256^3 to 80^3.
reason_for_revision.audit_truth_status: SIMBA CV16 was already historical/development truth before V14; no Swift-EAGLE, Astrid, or additional EAGLE truth was read.
reason_for_revision.decision: Use one exact cell-centred CIC raw-particle operator for TNG100, SIMBA, Swift-EAGLE, and sealed Astrid. Exclude all CMD targets from V14 fitting and gating.

common_target_operator.source: all PartType1/Coordinates at z=0 from the raw snapshot
common_target_operator.particle_mass_requirement: all dark-matter particles have one identical positive mass; fail preparation otherwise
common_target_operator.zero_policy: fail preparation if any selected cube cell is non-positive; no pseudocount, clipping, censoring, or learned floor
common_target_operator.mass_conservation: require float64 deposited mass to equal the selected particle count and float32 cache relative error <=1e-7
common_target_operator.storage_tolerance_amendment: The original 2e-8 bound was tightened below the 4.75e-8 representation error of the exact CAMELS mean count 32.768 in a synthetic uniform-grid test. It was changed to 1e-7 before preparation or model fitting; the CIC operator and physical target are unchanged.
forbidden: CAMELS Multifield Dataset adaptive-smoothed grids as a V14 target
mixing NGP, CIC, adaptive-kernel, or suite-specific target operators

allowed_uses: retain and report the immutable V13 decision and metrics after V14 freeze
forbidden_uses: model, feature, target-operator, or normalization fitting
amplitude, seed, threshold, or gate tuning

tng100.observer_partitions: the exact existing V13 train and validation IDs
tng100.input_policy: copy the existing two observable channels and metadata exactly
tng100.target_policy: replace target only from the new full-box CIC cache using the existing cube origins

camels_simba.legacy_cmd_policy: excluded from all V14 fitting, selection, and gate decisions
camels_simba.historical_stress_policy: regenerate with common CIC and report only after V14 development selection; never fit or select on it

camels_swift_eagle.reason: Public Swift hydrodynamics with EAGLE subgrid physics supplies an EAGLE-like shift without reopening EAGLE RefL0100N1504.
camels_swift_eagle.training_observers: all subhalos satisfying the frozen observer stellar-mass interval
camels_swift_eagle.validation_selection: exactly 16 observers selected once by deterministic maximin coverage of the eight V8 observable context features; no target or density feature

sealed_independent_domain.objects: one observer per realization, chosen by the frozen stellar-mass-only rule
sealed_independent_domain.observer_choice: candidate closest in log stellar mass to the geometric midpoint of 4e10 to 1e11 Msun in the existing CAMELS catalog convention, subhalo index tie breaker
sealed_independent_domain.cmd_grid_policy: do not download or use the Astrid CMD grid for V14
access_firewall: Do not download, open, mmap, summarize, or derive any Astrid snapshot, catalog, CMD grid, or target before the complete V14 model, preprocessing, checkpoint, hashes, and gate command are frozen and committed.
After freeze, prepare all 27 objects and open the field gate exactly once.
A failed gate remains failed; no alternate checkpoint, seed, realization subset, target operator, correction, or threshold is tried.

field_gate.checks: the same eight checks and thresholds used by V13

allowed: fit and compare models using only TNG100, SIMBA development, and Swift-EAGLE development CIC truth
use target-free observable context at inference
train a conditional multiscale location-scale likelihood
require simultaneous unchanged field-gate passes on all three development validation domains
forbidden: simulation identity as an inference feature
post-hoc A(k) or truth-derived amplitude correction
EAGLE RefL0100N1504 or Astrid-driven model choice

locked_order: build common-CIC TNG and download/prepare raw-CIC SIMBA and Swift-EAGLE development data
implement and select V14 only on the three development domains
freeze and commit exact V14 artifact hashes and one-shot command
download and prepare raw-CIC Astrid data
run the Astrid field gate once
run Astrid grid-HOP only after a field pass
advance only after the complete independent gate passes

unavailable_alternative.policy: Do not claim Magneticum as an executable independent gate without access and a separately committed protocol.
